doc.notes: One served pocket (the right middle). A 141.32 mm run along −Z dropping 18.67, a 90° plan turn, a 200 mm run along +X dropping 20, then a level 300 mm tray. TEST reads chosen from the table's own dimensions with clearances (below the bed, inside the apron ring |Z| < 775.8, away from the legs); nothing here is a claim about any real slide. Purpose: two touching balls rounding the corner must keep a 3-D centre distance of exactly one diameter. Revision r2 (2026-09-10, #737 r12 / ORDER-BR-737-FIX10 ruling (a)): the entry moved 10.0 mm DOWN ITS OWN RUN, measurement-corrected against the generic table's body — see the runway provenance. The topology this fixture pins is unchanged: one entry run, a 90° plan turn at the same vertex, one tray.

PROXY: the kernel default class (params.rs ClothPreset::default, u_r 0.010 — Waldron stimpmeter roll-out, a first-hand cloth measurement) stands in for the unmeasured steel-wire class. On the twin rail the effective coefficient is (7/5)(r/ρ)·u_r = 1.4 × 1.322 × 0.010 = 0.0185 (track.js resistCoeff); drain margin at the shallowest edge: sin θ 0.0436 vs 0.0185.

research.md R5 / the brief's 'inelastic arrival' and the owner's 「一个接一个堆」: arriving balls share a common velocity with the group they touch, the tray wall is infinite mass. A modelling decision, NOT a measurement — no ball-on-ball impact in a return tray has been captured in this repo; a measured e would enter through this block and a runtime law change (spec §7).

synthetic geometry for the chord-spacing arm (clearances stated in doc.notes), entry MEASUREMENT-CORRECTED (#737 r12, ORDER-BR-737-FIX10 ruling (a)). The authored entry at Y −263 left 47.196 mm of clear runway above it — V20's own read on the live wpa_generic_9ft, bisected off the 0.005 m scan interval, not the grid figure — which is 9.954 mm short of the one ball diameter (57.15 mm) the landing law seats an arriving ball in, so the band above the entry stood inside obTable/ExtrudeGeometry@(0,-124,0)[2926×260×1656], the generic table's body: 3 drawn stations, worst 9.87 mm deep. The entry moves along its own run by that minimal distance: 9.954 mm, taken UP to the 0.1 mm export grain (track.js EXPORT_GRAIN) as 10.0 mm; written at the fixture's own 0.01 mm vertex precision the realised move is 10.009 mm, and V20 now reads the full diameter clear with 0.055 mm to spare. Residual off the run's line 7.3 µm (two orders below the grain); X stays exactly 0, so the plan bend is unchanged to the bit (90.00000° of deviation at the vertex). First run now 141.32 mm dropping 18.67 (sin θ 0.132113 vs 0.132164 — the 0.01 mm rounding, not the move — still above the 0.0185 effective coefficient this fixture states in rolling_resistance).
